$description: Lumen v0.13 — Phase 0 spacing namespace. Mirrors the master doc's 10-stop structural ladder (8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80, 96, 128) as `spacing.1` through `spacing.16` (the keys are quarter-units so spacing.1 = dimension.2 = 8 px). Aliases the existing `dimension.*` primitives — no new values, no drift. Engineers prefer `semantic/space.tokens.json` for product code; this file is the Phase 0 ALIAS that gives the master doc's named ladder a discoverable home. Off-grid exceptions are re-exposed at the bottom as `exception.*` so a lint pass can fast-find them.

1.$description: 8 px — ladder stop 1. Tight gap (chip padding, segmented inner gap).

2.$description: 16 px — ladder stop 2. Default control gap, input internal padding y-axis.

3.$description: 24 px — ladder stop 3. Card internal padding, group separator.

4.$description: 32 px — ladder stop 4. Section internal gutter.

5.$description: 40 px — ladder stop 5. Tab-bar inner padding, dense form gutter.

8.$description: 64 px — ladder stop 8. Section vertical rhythm — operator surfaces.

10.$description: 80 px — ladder stop 10. Section vertical rhythm — marketing surfaces.

12.$description: 96 px — ladder stop 12. Hero block vertical rhythm.

16.$description: 128 px — ladder stop 16. Top-level page rhythm, brutalist hero anchor.

exception.$description: v0.13 — named off-grid exceptions, called out in master doc §6. NO new exceptions without a new named token here. CI lint `lint:no-off-grid-spacing` checks against this allowlist.

space-1_5.$description: 6 px — sub-grid 6 px gap. Optical inner-padding tier between 4 and 8. Documented exception per spacing.md §1.

size-control-cozy.$description: 36 px — settings-panel sweet spot control height. Density tier between sm (32) and md (40).

radius-xs.$description: 3 px — hairline-accent radius. Optical concern, not subject to 4-pt grid.

size-dot-md.$description: 8 px — LiveDot inner-dot signature size. v0.12.6 anchor; master doc Phase 0 also names a 19 px composite measure exposed as `size.dot.touch` (the dot+pulse-ring extent).

size-dot-touch.$description: v0.13 NEW — 19 px LiveDot composite touch extent (8 px dot + 5 px pulse ring on each side + 1 px outline). Named off-grid exception per master doc §6.

shadow-focus-ring.$description: v0.13 NEW — 3 px focus-ring spread thickness. Consumed by shadow.focus + the `:focus-visible` outline rule per AGENTS hard rule 11.
